message.content:
Here’s a quick reference for the **federal long‑weekends** in Canada during 2023.  
(If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can add the provincial holidays that create extra long weekends.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Monday, Feb 20 | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Friday, Apr 7 | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | Monday, May 22 | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 |
| Labour Day | Monday, Sep 4 | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Monday, Oct 9 | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 |
| Christmas Day | Monday, Dec 25 | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 |

> **Notes**  
> • New Year’s Day (Jan 1) and Canada Day (Jul 1) fell on Saturdays in 2023, so they didn’t create a long weekend.  
> • Remembrance Day (Thu Nov 11) and Boxing Day (Tue Dec 26) were weekdays but did not extend a weekend.
